services.desc: You don’t have to venture far outside of Seward to find yourself in the wild. Mountains tower over our picturesque little harbor, and just beyond the breakwall is the vast wilderness of Kenai Fjords. The national park boasts the Harding Ice field which feeds dozens of glaciers; some flowing to tidewater, others pouring into the sea through massive waterfalls along with snowmelt from the surrounding peaks. Thousands of seabirds congregate along the rocky shorelines, while whales, sea lions, otters, and seals swim beneath the surface of the waves. It’s in this majestic place that we welcome you aboard Hope and invite you to explore the remote Southcentral coasts of Alaska with us. Our private

quotes.text: AMAZING!!! Jason and his team are top notch! We had such an AWESOME experience exploring the Kenai Fjords, catching fish, whale watching and eating like kings. Would recommend this trip and team to anyone looking to go to AK for the first time, or looking to revisit with new adventures in mind!

I can’t even put into words how incredible this experience was for myself and my husband! Jason and his crew were just wonderful! So much better than being packed in on one of those big boats. These guys were amazing! We highly recommend this company."—Monika, Google Reviews

We had the most amazing trip on the Hope. They were very knowledgeable about the area, the wildlife, and the fishing. It was a top notch day and we’d do it again and recommend them to anyone! Fantastic!"—Josiah, TripAdvisor

Absolutely great day on the water with Jason! Boat was clean and spacious, deckhand was super efficient, and we limited out on halibut and silvers. As a Seward local, I highly recommend! Thanks Jason!
Had a fabulous experience with Capt Jason and Garret. We had a great day and caught some Halibut, Rockfish, and Salmon. Beautiful scenery, great boat and friendly crew." — Brian, Google Reviews
